summary: Implemented the product-decided three-state CRM delivery banner logic. A solo/non-firm workspace now resolves to an explicit idle (no delivery configured) state and renders no banner. A configured firm relay renders no banner after it reports live, while a configured relay that has not connected or has stopped remains offline and shows the existing Working offline warning. The user-facing state is derived from the same active shared-matter plus firmMatterId check that starts the real relay, which also prevents a one-frame false warning when moving from firm to solo. Added regression coverage for all three states and kept solo-only freshness labels healthy rather than replacing the banner with another needs-attention message.

assumptions: The real relay-configuration source of truth remains the existing useLiveCrmRecords check: the active matter must be shared and have a firmMatterId, and a workspace root must be open. The fix derives idle versus relay-applicable state from that same check rather than inventing a second firm-mode flag.
A configured relay's idle transport status still maps to offline because delivery exists but is not connected. The new CRM idle state means only that no firm delivery relay applies to this workspace.
Preview mode is local sample data with no configured firm relay, so it now uses idle and does not show the delivery warning.
